# OpenReceive

> Open-source libraries for accepting inbound Bitcoin Lightning payments
> directly into a wallet the application owner controls, plus a BTCPay Server
> plugin that does the same for a BTCPay store. OpenReceive never holds funds,
> has no accounts or API keys, and connects through a receive-only Nostr
> Wallet Connect (NWC) code. This index describes OpenReceive 0.4.5.

Every documentation link below is raw markdown — fetch it directly, no browser
needed. Appending `.md` to any guide page URL returns the same document as
markdown.

## Start here

- [Express quickstart (Node)](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-node.md): Express server with any frontend
- [Fastify quickstart](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-fastify.md)
- [Next.js quickstart](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-next.md): the App Router catch-all route and a client-component checkout
- [Rails quickstart](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-rails.md)
- [PHP quickstart (plain PHP)](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-php.md): a front controller, a PDO handle, three methods and the standalone checkout tarball
- [Laravel quickstart](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-laravel.md): composer require openreceive/laravel, php artisan openreceive:install, a Host class and the element through Vite
- [Django quickstart](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-django.md): the installable app, the ORM-backed payment tables, manage.py openreceive_install
- [BTCPay Server quickstart](https://openreceive.org/guides/quickstart-btcpay.md): the OpenReceive plugin, a receive-only NWC wallet as a store's Lightning node
- [Agent directions, Node (Express)](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/node.md): a self-contained integration prompt for a coding agent, quickstart inlined
- [Agent directions, Fastify](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/fastify.md)
- [Agent directions, Next.js](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/next.md)
- [Agent directions, Rails](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/rails.md)
- [Agent directions, PHP](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/php.md)
- [Agent directions, Laravel](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/laravel.md)
- [Agent directions, Django](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/django.md)
- [Agent directions, BTCPay Server](https://openreceive.org/agent-directions/btcpay.md)

## Machine-readable specifications

- [OpenReceive HTTP OpenAPI](https://openreceive.org/openapi.yaml): the normative contract for every mounted route

## Agent resources

- [Using OpenReceive with coding agents](https://openreceive.org/agents.md): skills, install commands, and which artifact answers which question
- [Agent skills](https://github.com/OpenReceive/openreceive/tree/master/skills): integrate-openreceive and debug-openreceive-payment — `npx skills add OpenReceive/openreceive`, or Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add OpenReceive/openreceive`
- [Contributor rules](https://github.com/OpenReceive/openreceive/blob/master/AGENTS.md): the invariants for changes to OpenReceive itself
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/OpenReceive/openreceive)
